plotEn:
Hank Goldstone is a mild-mannered employee at furniture company Raynard & Ferguson, husband to his wife Melanie, and father to his 13-year-old son Zion. Zion is a fan of hip-hop music, and desperately appeals to his parents to attend the Rolling Loud music festival. Initially, Hank and Melanie refuse, but Hank eventually relents and buys tickets. Melanie is not convinced, leading Hank to lie to her, telling her that he is taking Zion to the family cabin, but surprising Zion by heading to Rolling Loud instead.
At the festival, the two are initially turned away, as Zion is too young to attend. Hank lies and says that he is 16 to get past security. While Zion is in the bathroom, Hank has a chance meeting with his eccentric coworker Terry, who is also his boss’s son. Hank and Terry eat lunch together, but Hank becomes concerned when Zion does not return from the bathroom, and is unable to contact him due to the festival’s poor cell phone service. With Terry tagging along, Hank searches for Zion. During the search, Hank takes a call from Melanie in a karaoke booth that is overheard and filmed by a crowd outside.
Hank eventually goes to security, who question Hank about Zion’s real age and threaten to call child protective services. Terry appears with a stage pyrotechnic device, distracting security long enough for the two of them to escape.
